findings: The retained November5 ordinance index already linked all five recovered documents; it was reused, not fetched again. Boone records were inspected for routing only and no Boone sources were acquired in this phase.

Original Ordinance2025-37 paused hyperscale permits pending adoption of zoning regulations for such projects, with a one-year maximum. Later signed Ordinance2026-34 adopts defined commercial-data-center prohibition October19/2026. Its effect clause requires passage and publication; actual legal publication has not been established.

The definition includes hyperscale, crypto-mining and server farms but preserves defined exclusions, including certain telecom/public-broadband infrastructure and bounded accessory IT rooms. The prohibition is not described as a ban on every computing installation.

2026-34 includes infrastructure-circumvention provisions for prohibited data centers and expressly does not repeal/replace standalone BESS rules for permitted uses. Its repeal clause applies to conflicts; it does not name2025-37 explicitly. The moratorium adoption-trigger relationship and publication/current force remain distinguished.

Signed solar Ordinance2026-16 and BESS Ordinance2026-17 were adoptedJune1/2026, with printed July25/2026 effective dates. PlanCommission recommendations datedMay20 are not substituted for board adoption.
Full extensions2026-02 and03, adoptedFebruary17, extend solar Ordinance07-2025 and BESS Ordinance06-2025 throughJuly25/2026. Original enactment dates of those two2025 ordinances remain unverified.

These documents support recorded replacement histories rather than an active data moratorium or an unexplained solar/storage lapse alone. Actual publication, complete later amendments/challenges and project-specific applicability remain open.

The planning-recommendation cover retains a typed2026-26 reference while the signed ordinance heading is handwritten2026-34; the signed ordinance identity is visually verified and the cover discrepancy is retained rather than silently normalized.
